regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and central graphical reaction summary
regions.finding: The original page image shows the current ZnBr2/CuBr-mediated reaction class with aggregate 40–73% yield and 92–99% ee. It is represented as a general scheme, not as one experiment-specific run.

regions.region: page 1 lower two-column introduction and references 1–6
regions.finding: The text introduces the prior chiral-amine approach and cited allene literature. These references are prior work; no current-paper table row or independently specified experiment appears in this region.

unresolved: The abstract/graphical summary uses generic R groups and aggregate ranges, so it cannot be decomposed into unique experiments without later tables.
The page mentions Supporting Information in a citation note, but source mapping leaves SI association unestablished.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Scheme 1, prior-study panels a(1)–a(2) and current-work panel b
regions.finding: The generic alpha-oxy-alkyne prior route is classified as a prior general scheme; the specific 1-dodecyne/benzaldehyde result (31%, 82% ee) is a literature example; panel b is the same aggregate current-work overview as page 1 and is merged with it.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1–5, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Five independent optimization experiments were retained. Entry 1 has 22% NMR 4ba, missing ee, and 7% NMR 5ba; entry 4 also has 8% NMR 5ba. Shared quantities, isolated-yield basis, chiral-HPLC ee basis, and row-specific metal loadings/temperature/time were applied.

regions.region: page 2 optimization and scope prose surrounding Scheme 1/Table 1
regions.finding: Narrative statements map to the five Table 1 rows and the Table 2 scope on page 3; no duplicate prose-only experiments were created. Unquantified additive-screen names are context and were not assigned to invented rows.

unresolved: The generic prior scheme omits unique structures and most conditions.
Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
The numerous named additives in prose have no row-by-row conditions or outcomes and were not reconstructed.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 2 reaction header, rows 1–14, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Fourteen condition-A and twelve condition-B scope experiments were retained separately, plus the distinct 4 mmol entry-10 scale-up. The 10 mol% CuBr footnote applies only to A entries 2, 8, and 9; entry 12 A retains the minor-impurity warning.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Scheme 2 eqs 1–4 and control-experiment prose
regions.finding: The ZnBr2-only 13 h/22% NMR condition is the same experiment as Table 1 entry 1 and was merged. Four other controls were retained separately: CuBr-only one-pot formation of 5ba/4ba and three isolated-5ba conversion experiments. The 31% and 65% values are reactant recovery by NMR, not product yields.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 3 and adjacent mechanism discussion
regions.finding: The Re-face attack, 1,5-hydride-transfer, and beta-elimination cycle is explicitly proposed and is classified as mechanism rather than observed preparative steps.

unresolved: Table 2 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses; allene structures and axial configurations remain machine-unverified.
The scale-up footnote does not state absolute alkyne/aldehyde quantities, solvent volume, or yield basis.
Scheme 2 omits several scales, volumes, yield bases, and ee methods; Scheme 3 intermediates are proposed.

regions.region: page 4 upper two-column continuation of Scheme 3 discussion and conclusion
regions.finding: The text continues the proposed beta-elimination/Cu-Zn cooperation model and summarizes the study. The stated >70% per-step value is a mechanistic interpretation, not a new isolated experiment outcome.

regions.region: page 4 Supporting Information statement, acknowledgments, and references 8–10
regions.finding: The paper says procedures and characterization are available as SI, but source mapping marks the association unestablished; no SI facts were imported. The remainder is funding, declarations, and prior literature, not current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The mechanistic >70% per-step estimate is not an experiment-specific yield and was not structured as one.
Supporting Information association remains unestablished; external references were not expanded into experiments.
